full_judgment:
9. Being aggrieved by and dissatisfied with the impugned judgment and order of conviction and sentence dated 26-2-2019 passed by the learned Divisional Special Judge, Khulna in Special Case No.05 of 2018 arising out of Dawlatpur Police Station Case No.06 dated 11-5-2004 corresponding to GR No.492 of 2004 the convict-appellant preferred this Appeal, before this Hon'ble High Court Division. 

 22. In his cross he stated that he did not remember whether he had measured the house of the said accused on 24-9-2003. He signed all these documents are photocopies. He is a Diploma Engineer. He signed the documents upon sitting in the office, cannot remember whether anyone else sat in the office and signed. He did not know whether Raj Mistri was called for the assistants. He did not know whether any information was received by calling the suppliers of construction materials and giving the report. He did not know the daily wages of the masons and the daily wages of the laborers during the construction of the house. He did not know the price of bricks, sand and cement at that time. He does not know when their officers went there and when they signed. This signature on this photocopy is his signature. He denied that statement of assets submitted by the accused was correct or that they prepared the report on seating in the office without visiting the place of occurrence practically and gave false evidence.
